origin_drain_backend_rule.definition: type in ['TRANSFER', 'CASH_OUT'] AND old_balance_orig > 0 AND new_balance_orig == 0 AND amount >= old_balance_orig * 0.95. When old_balance_orig == 0, drain is strictly False.

single_feature_pr_auc.sign_direction_methodology: Evaluated strictly on TRAIN and VALIDATION (test numbers excluded). Direction sign ('+' / '-') indicates whether larger (+) or smaller (-) values correlate with fraud risk: pr_pos = PR-AUC(+x), pr_neg = PR-AUC(-x). Reported pr_auc = max(pr_pos, pr_neg).
